name: Translucydity
source:
You can either play as an 18yo trans woman called Lucy or as Father Maynard. These two might be at odds from the start, but any hostility between them is not long to be. Or is it?

[From [url=https://chummychonka.itch.io/translucydity]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你可以扮演一位名叫露西的18岁跨性别女性，也可以扮演梅纳德神父。这两个人可能从一开始就存在分歧，但他们之间的敌意不会持续太久。或者是吗？

[来自[url=https://chummychonka.itch.io/translucydity]Itch.io[/url]]
